_comment: The two entries above and below are the only checks this environment genuinely cannot run: no synchronous prompt render in the installed host, and no file symlink on Windows without elevation. CI passes --skip ledger for a third: tests/ledger.test.mjs guards the project ledger that lives BESIDE this package, so a clean checkout cannot read it at all.
